review.description: Successful metadata queries reuse scoped cached state until expiry/invalidation; explicit live checks bypass query/REST/GraphQL TTLs and update cache state. Observation times, head/scope freshness and summary import semantics remain accurate across restart.
review.implementation: GitHubSource separates the app from its adapter. CachedGitHub decorates all remote read methods with bounded private query storage and scoped invalidation, while delegating local quota accounting. RequireLive is explicit at execution, new-notification targets, post-turn receipt checks and manual polling; live failures never use old success.
review.tests: Provider regressions verify cached HTTP counts, expiry, invalidation, direct write-through, persistence/principal separation, concurrent cache-hit availability, GraphQL bypass, immutable copies, summary flags and original observation timestamps, changed head/update detail invalidation and preservation of unrelated repositories. Application tests prove warm cache cannot authorize a closed source and post-turn receipt refresh bypasses saved cache while retaining observations on failure.
